name: wds_imagenet-a
description: ImageNet-A is a curated set of naturally occurring, hard-to-classify images drawn from the ImageNet corpus designed to probe model robustness to real-world distribution shifts and adversarial natural examples. It measures a model's top-1 classification performance on these challenging images, highlighting brittleness that standard ImageNet validation accuracy does not reveal. Researchers use it to evaluate robustness, generalization, and the effectiveness of defenses or robust training methods.
reputation: Widely cited in robustness and adversarial-vision research as a standard stress-test for image classifiers.
